slides.title: We don't design *anything* until we've listened.
Deep Listen.
slides.body: We learn your business, your customers, your competitors and what success means to you.

slides.title: Truth Finding.
slides.body: What do you genuinely do better than anyone else? It's rarely the first thing a founder says.

slides.title: Positioning.
slides.body: One clear statement every post, ad and web page gets measured against.

slides.title: Identity Design.
slides.body: Only now do colours, logos and words come in. Built on strategy, not on taste.

slides.title: Guidelines.
slides.body: A brand book your team can use, so the brand stays consistent long after we hand it over.

caption:
People expect an agency to start with logos and colour palettes. We start with questions.

We call it the Illumination Process: Deep Listen, Truth Finding, Positioning, Identity Design and Guidelines.

Design without strategy is decoration. It might look nice, but it won't tell anyone why to choose you.

If your brand looks good but still doesn't bring in the right customers, DM us "LISTEN".
